content:
emma: Heads up — seen a weird intermittent SocketTimeoutException in our Android SDK when users are on corp VPN + proxy chain. Happens during streaming generation calls. Anyone else?

raj: Seen similar once. Can you paste logs + OkHttp config?

emma: Paste logs and config:
```
W/OkHttp: Failed to read from socket
java.net.SocketTimeoutException: timeout
	at okio.Timeout$TimedOutException: timed out
	...
Caused by: java.io.IOException: unexpected end of stream
```
OkHttp builder:
```
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) // streaming
  .callTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(5,5,TimeUnit.MINUTES))
```

sarah: streaming with readTimeout=0 is normal but on some proxies read timeout handling is weird. Which okhttp version?

emma: 4.9.3

luis: aha — old known bug where ProxySelector cached unreachable proxies and OkHttp's retry interacts badly with streaming reads. Upgrade to >=4.10.0 or apply this workaround: set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) and implement a custom retry that checks for streaming.

raj: Also check `call.timeout` defaults. For streaming we usually use readTimeout = 0 but callTimeout still applies. try `.callTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)` explicitly or set per-request timeouts.

emma: callTimeout already 0 in config above. still happens only when VPN + company proxy; no repro on plain wifi. :thinking: 

sarah: Could be HTTP/2 flow-control + proxy that terminates TLS and downgrades to h2. Try forcing HTTP/1.1 as a quick repro: `.protocols(listOf(Protocol.HTTP_1_1))` — does it still fail?

emma: good idea — will try later today and report. thanks!

ci-bot: deploy-bot posted: `canary sdk-android@build-456 passed` :rocket: 

luis: if it reproduces, please capture tcpdump + proxy logs. Also try `connectionPool.evictAll()` after long-lived streams to avoid stale sockets.

emma: Will collect traces. If one of you has a short patch suggestion we can ship as a hotfix for 0.12.x branch.

raj: If upgrade fixes it, hotfix to bump okhttp to 4.11.0 in 0.12.x and add a note in upgrade guide. :+1: 

emma: OK will test and update thread.
